diagnosis: The InitiateAvatarUpload Echo handler generates presigned avatar upload URLs for the specified profileID parameter. Although JWT middleware is present, the handler does not ensure profileID matches the caller's own profile ID, allowing authenticated users to generate upload sessions and replace avatar images for other profiles.
exploit_request:
POST /users/profiles/prof_user_882/avatar-upload HTTP/1.1
Host: social.community-feed.io
Authorization: Bearer valid_jwt_other_user
Content-Length: 0
